name: Gao tim than
summary: Gạo tím than is purple rice from Lò gạch cũ Farmstay in thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh, listed at 3 stars. It is also called gạo tím than lò gạch cũ.
origin: Thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh.
howToEat: Purple rice, also called gạo tím than lò gạch cũ.
where: Lò gạch cũ Farmstay, thôn Vĩnh Nam, xã Duy Vinh.
Also called gạo tím than lò gạch cũ at the fair of 22–24 Sep 2023.
